# Sunny Day Family

> A practical resource for busy families offering organizing tips, home management strategies, DIY projects, and kid-friendly activities.

Sunny Day Family is a family lifestyle blog created by Laura featuring home organization hacks, parenting tips, seasonal activities, and creative projects. The site emphasizes practical solutions for busy families, from decluttering and meal planning to holiday celebrations and pet care.

## Key Topics

- Home Organization
- Decluttering
- Family Activities
- Kids Crafts
- Printables
- Seasonal Planning
- Mom Hacks
- KonMari Method
- Holiday Planning
- DIY Projects
- Pet Care
- Kids Entertainment
- Cleaning Tips
- Family Routines
- Cricut Projects

## Core Hubs

- [Sunny Day Family](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com): Homepage for Sunny Day Family blog by Laura with organizing tips and mom life hacks
- [Get Organized](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/get-organized.html): Main organizing and home management hub covering cleaning, meal planning, and decluttering
- [Family Life](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/moms-kids.html): Family life and parenting content with kids activities, routines, and mom hacks
- [Holidays & Celebrations](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/holidays-celebrations.html): Seasonal guide with holiday planning, celebration ideas, and Year Round Holiday Planner

## DIY, Home & Pets

- [DIY & Home](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/diy-home.html): DIY projects, home decor, and Cricut ideas for home organization and improvement
- [Pets](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/p/pets.html): Pet-themed activities, care tips, and organization strategies for families with pets

## Organizing & Decluttering

- [5 Things To Do Every Day to Keep Your House Clean and Organized](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2015/04/5-clean-house.html): Daily house cleaning checklist and routine tips for busy families to stay organized
- [7 Things Marie Kondo Says To Do Every Day | Free Printable Konmari Checklist](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2019/01/printable-konmari-checklist.html): Daily to-do list inspired by Marie Kondo's KonMari method with free printable checklist
- [50 Things to Declutter in 15 Minutes a Day | Free Printable List](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2019/01/list-of-things-to-declutter.html): Comprehensive decluttering list with printable checklist for 15-minute daily tasks

## Holiday Activities & Crafts

- [St. Patrick's Day Scavenger Hunt for Kids | Printable](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/02/st-patricks-day-scavenger-hunt.html): Printable St. Patrick's Day scavenger hunt activity with leprechaun pot of gold clues
- [How to Organize the Best Easter Egg Hunt Ever](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/03/best-easter-egg-hunt.html): Tips for organizing and planning the perfect Easter egg hunt for families
- [Shake It Up Hearts: No Mess Valentine Craft for Preschoolers](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2016/01/shake-up-hearts.html): No-mess Valentine craft activity for preschoolers and toddlers to make cards

## Kids Activities & Learning

- [Make Your Own Book for Kids | Free Printable](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/02/make-your-own-book-for-kids.html): Free printable template for kids to create their own books with creative writing
- [The Ultimate Guide to Summer Reading Programs for Kids](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2017/07/summer-reading-log.html): Guide to summer reading programs for kids with printable reading log and incentives
- [12 Educational Podcasts Kids (and Adults!) Will Love](https://www.sunnydayfamily.com/2025/06/educational-podcasts-for-kids.html): Curated list of 12 educational podcasts for kids covering science, history, and facts
